bun /s/strato.ts set linear:ENG-12 status=<working|closed> waiting=<first name or -> why="<why it is for Alice, one sentence>" steps="<the plan: 3 to 7 steps separated by |, each prefixed done: now: or todo:, a single now>" blocker="<what blocks the now step and who, one sentence, or ->" mrs="<the merge requests, repo!N separated by |, or ->" due="<the deadlines, HH:MM text separated by |, or ->" unverified="<what is not checked, or nothing>" next="<next action, one sentence>" summary="<two sentences at most>" report=/state/reports/linear_ENG-12.md
2. What waits for Alice: one task per thing to decide or to send, never two things in one task. Every message to post is its own kind=draft task, with its exact text and its destination: two messages (a notice and a DM) are two draft tasks, never one action "post X then DM Y". Alice reads each text before it goes out.
bun /s/strato.ts task linear:ENG-12 add kind=action ask="<what is asked, one sentence>" proposal="<what you propose, one sentence>" action="<the exact action that goes out on go>"
bun /s/strato.ts task linear:ENG-12 add kind=decision ask="<the choice Alice has to make, one sentence>" proposal="<the option you recommend, one sentence>"
bun /s/strato.ts task linear:ENG-12 add kind=question ask="<the question to Alice, one sentence>" proposal="<your best answer, if you have one>"
`add` prints the id of the task (t1, t2…). The topic shows "waiting on you" as long as one of its tasks is open: never set status=gate yourself.
bun /s/strato.ts task linear:ENG-12 done <id> note="<what was done, with the link>": as soon as you have carried the task out (posted, merged, created, run), in the same turn.
bun /s/strato.ts task linear:ENG-12 drop <id> note="<why>": the task no longer applies (answered elsewhere, overtaken, refused).
bun /s/strato.ts task linear:ENG-12 edit <id> key=value…: to fix the same task (the wording of a draft, its destination). A different request is a new task, never an edit.
An open task is a button Alice can press: before stopping, every task you no longer stand behind is done or dropped.
If Alice asks for something that is not this topic, propose to open a new topic for it instead of rewriting this topic's tasks.
Values between double quotes: escape the ", $ and backticks they contain. A value - empties the field.

- You are blocked by a question to Alice: a task kind=question or kind=decision.
